meaning.en: A grand occasion on a scale never seen before.
meaning.zh: 热烈隆重的情况是从来没有过的。

examples.zh: 今年的博览会盛况空前。
examples.en: This year's expo was a spectacle on an unprecedented scale.

examples.zh: 开幕式盛况空前，吸引了数万名观众。
examples.en: The opening ceremony drew a record crowd of tens of thousands.

usage.zh: 多作谓语；常见于新闻报道。

meaning.en: To move someone by appealing to their feelings (often paired with 晓之以理, 'reason with them').
meaning.zh: 用感情来打动对方。

examples.zh: 对待犯错的学生，要晓之以理，动之以情。
examples.en: With pupils who misbehave, reason with them and appeal to their feelings.

examples.zh: 他动之以情，终于说服了父亲。
examples.en: By appealing to his father's emotions he finally won him over.

usage.en: Usually in 晓之以理，动之以情.

meaning.en: To secretly swap the real thing for a fake; to substitute by trickery.
meaning.zh: 比喻暗中玩弄手法，以假代真，以劣代优。

examples.zh: 不法商家偷梁换柱，用劣质材料冒充正品。
examples.en: Dodgy traders pull a switch, passing off cheap materials as the real thing.

examples.zh: 他在合同里偷梁换柱，改了关键条款。
examples.en: He slipped a change into the contract, swapping out a key clause.

story.en: The 25th of the Thirty-Six Stratagems: secretly replace the enemy's best units to weaken them from within.
story.zh: 《三十六计》第二十五计“偷梁换柱”。

date.zh: 明清之际 · 17世纪（成书年代不详）

meaning.en: To be passed on as a fine story worth telling.
meaning.zh: 被流传为美好的故事。

equivalents: a story people love to tell

examples.zh: 他们俩相濡以沫的故事在村里传为佳话。
examples.en: Their devoted marriage became a much-told story in the village.

examples.zh: 这次跨国救援被传为佳话。
examples.en: The international rescue is now talked about as a heartwarming tale.

meaning.en: Covered in dust and dirt; also, looking humiliated or dejected.
meaning.zh: 满头满脸都是尘土；也形容消沉、丢脸的样子。

examples.zh: 他在工地干了一天，弄得灰头土脸。
examples.en: After a day on the building site he was covered in grime.

examples.zh: 计划失败，他灰头土脸地回来了。
examples.en: The plan failed and he came back with egg on his face.

meaning.en: To lower the flags and silence the drums; to stop fighting or quietly halt an activity.
meaning.zh: 放倒旗子，停止敲鼓，指秘密行军或停止战斗；也比喻停止某项活动。

examples.zh: 双方偃旗息鼓，暂时停止了价格战。
examples.en: The two sides called a truce in their price war for now.

examples.zh: 这场争论很快就偃旗息鼓了。
examples.en: The row soon fizzled out.

origin.source: 《三国志·蜀书·赵云传》裴松之注引《云别传》

story.en: Zhao Yun, outnumbered by Cao Cao's army, flung open his camp gates, lowered the flags and silenced the drums; suspecting an ambush, Cao's troops withdrew.
story.zh: 《云别传》：“云入营，更大开门，偃旗息鼓。公军疑云有伏兵，引去。”

meaning.en: To win a complete victory.
meaning.zh: 取得全面的胜利。

examples.zh: 主队以三比零大获全胜。
examples.en: The home side won a resounding 3–0 victory.

examples.zh: 这次选举，他们党大获全胜。
examples.en: Their party won a landslide in the election.

natural: stand by each other through thick and thin

meaning.en: To share hardships together.
meaning.zh: 共同承担危险和困难。

examples.zh: 他们是患难与共的老朋友。
examples.en: They're old friends who've stood by each other through thick and thin.

examples.zh: 夫妻俩患难与共，一起创业。
examples.en: The couple shared every hardship as they built the business together.

antonyms: 夫妻本是同林鸟，大难临头各自飞

meaning.en: Constantly busy.
meaning.zh: 形容事情繁多，不停地操劳。

examples.zh: 她每天忙忙碌碌，很少有空休息。
examples.en: She's busy every day and seldom has time to rest.

examples.zh: 忙忙碌碌一整年，终于可以回家过年了。
examples.en: After a whole year of rushing about, I can finally go home for New Year.

meaning.en: A stream of thoughts and associations comes to mind.
meaning.zh: 许许多多的想象不断涌现出来。

examples.zh: 望着老照片，他浮想联翩。
examples.en: Looking at the old photos, his mind filled with memories.

examples.zh: 这首诗让读者浮想联翩。
examples.en: The poem sets readers' imaginations running.

usage.en: Predicate; often 让人浮想联翩.

meaning.en: Full of fervour and passion.
meaning.zh: 精神振奋，情绪激动，充满正气。

examples.zh: 他发表了一番慷慨激昂的演说。
examples.en: He gave a rousing speech.

examples.zh: 队长慷慨激昂地鼓励队友。
examples.en: The captain fired up his teammates with passionate words.

meaning.en: To settle down and make a home somewhere.
meaning.zh: 在某个地方安置家庭，长期居住。

examples.zh: 大学毕业后，他在深圳安家落户。
examples.en: After university he settled down in Shenzhen.

examples.zh: 大熊猫在这家动物园安家落户。
examples.en: The giant pandas have made their home at this zoo.

usage.en: Predicate; also for companies, animals, plants.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；也可用于企业、动植物。

meaning.en: Genuine, heartfelt feelings.
meaning.zh: 真实的情感。

examples.zh: 好的作文要写出真情实感。
examples.en: A good essay should express genuine feelings.

examples.zh: 他的演唱充满真情实感，打动了评委。
examples.en: His heartfelt singing moved the judges.

usage.zh: 多作宾语；常见于作文指导。

meaning.en: As inseparable as a body and its shadow.
meaning.zh: 像形体和它的影子那样分不开，形容关系密切。

examples.zh: 她俩从小形影不离。
examples.en: The two of them have been inseparable since childhood.

examples.zh: 那只小狗和主人形影不离。
examples.en: The puppy follows its owner everywhere.

meaning.en: Beautiful scenery of lakes and mountains.
meaning.zh: 湖的风光，山的景色，指美丽的自然景色。

examples.zh: 杭州的湖光山色令人陶醉。
examples.en: Hangzhou's lakes and hills are enchanting.

examples.zh: 我们一边划船，一边欣赏湖光山色。
examples.en: We rowed along, taking in the lake and mountain scenery.

meaning.en: To have a clear conscience.
meaning.zh: 扪心自问，毫无愧色。

equivalents: have nothing to be ashamed of

examples.zh: 我已经尽力了，问心无愧。
examples.en: I did my best, and my conscience is clear.

examples.zh: 只要问心无愧，别人怎么说都无所谓。
examples.en: As long as you have nothing to be ashamed of, never mind what others say.

synonyms: 不做亏心事，不怕鬼敲门

meaning.en: Over many years; for a long time.
meaning.zh: 形容经历了很长的时间。

examples.zh: 他长年累月在野外工作。
examples.en: He has worked in the field year in, year out.

examples.zh: 长年累月的熬夜损害了他的健康。
examples.en: Years of late nights have damaged his health.

natural: warm one day, cold the next

meaning.en: Warm one moment, cold again the next (of early spring weather).
meaning.zh: 形容冬末春初天气忽冷忽热。

equivalents: warm one day, cold the next

examples.zh: 初春时节乍暖还寒，要注意保暖。
examples.en: Early spring is warm one day and cold the next, so wrap up.

examples.zh: 三月的北京乍暖还寒。
examples.en: Beijing in March can't make up its mind between warm and cold.

story.en: Li Qingzhao's ci: 'In this season of sudden warmth and lingering cold, it is hardest to rest' (乍暖还寒时候，最难将息).
story.zh: 李清照《声声慢》：“乍暖还寒时候，最难将息。”

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; for early spring.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，形容早春天气。

meaning.en: To meddle in other people's business.
meaning.zh: 过多地过问与自己无关的事情。

examples.zh: 这是我的事，你别多管闲事。
examples.en: This is my business — mind your own.

examples.zh: 她总爱多管闲事，邻居都烦她。
examples.en: She's always poking her nose in, and the neighbours are fed up.

examples.zh: 你多管什么闲事！
examples.en: What's it to do with you!

usage.en: Predicate; often 别多管闲事. Can be split (多管什么闲事).
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“别多管闲事”；可拆开用。

synonyms: 看戏的掉眼泪——替古人担忧

meaning.en: To have successors to carry on one's work.
meaning.zh: 有继承前人事业的人。

equivalents: the future is in good hands

examples.zh: 看到年轻演员的表演，老艺术家欣慰地说：京剧后继有人了。
examples.en: Watching the young performers, the veteran said happily: Peking opera is in good hands.

examples.zh: 这门手艺后继有人，不会失传了。
examples.en: This craft has successors and won't be lost.

meaning.en: Brimming with self-satisfaction or confident ambition.
meaning.zh: 形容对自己的现状或取得的成就非常得意。

examples.zh: 新赛季开始，球队上下踌躇满志。
examples.en: At the start of the new season the whole team is full of confidence.

examples.zh: 刚毕业时，他踌躇满志，想干一番事业。
examples.en: Fresh out of university, he was brimming with ambition.

story.en: Cook Ding, having carved the ox with effortless skill, 'stands holding his knife, looking about him, utterly satisfied' (为之踌躇满志).
story.zh: 《庄子·养生主》：“提刀而立，为之四顾，为之踌躇满志，善刀而藏之。”

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

meaning.en: From all over the country; far apart; also, talking about anything and everything.
meaning.zh: 形容地域辽阔、相距遥远；也指说话漫无边际。

equivalents: chat about everything under the sun

examples.zh: 同学们来自天南海北。
examples.en: The students come from all over the country.

examples.zh: 我们俩坐在一起天南海北地聊了一晚上。
examples.en: We sat chatting about anything and everything all evening.

meaning.en: Brightly multicoloured, sometimes gaudy.
meaning.zh: 形容颜色鲜艳多彩。

examples.zh: 孩子们穿着花花绿绿的衣服去春游。
examples.en: The children went on their spring outing in brightly coloured clothes.

examples.zh: 街上贴满了花花绿绿的广告。
examples.en: The street was plastered with garish adverts.

natural: hit the nail on the head

meaning.en: To get to the heart of the matter in a single sentence.
meaning.zh: 一句话就说穿了。

equivalents: hit the nail on the head
sum it up in a word

examples.zh: 老师一语道破了问题的关键。
examples.en: The teacher put her finger on the crux of the problem in one sentence.

examples.zh: 他一语道破了对方的骗局。
examples.en: He exposed the scam with a single remark.

meaning.en: To bring order out of chaos and return to the right path.
meaning.zh: 消除混乱局面，恢复正常秩序。

examples.zh: 新领导上任后，大力拨乱反正。
examples.en: The new leadership worked hard to set things right.

examples.zh: 那段拨乱反正的历史值得研究。
examples.en: The period of restoring order is worth studying.

story.en: On the Spring and Autumn Annals: 'For clearing away a chaotic age and returning it to what is right, nothing comes close to the Annals' (拨乱世，反诸正，莫近诸《春秋》).
story.zh: 《公羊传》：“拨乱世，反诸正，莫近诸《春秋》。”

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; formal, political and historical.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语；书面语，多用于政治、历史。
